biography.value: Mind flayer arcanists boost their psionic powers with magic. Other mind flayers regard those who attempt such experiments with revulsion and fear.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can teleport the target up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see on a surface or liquid large enough to support the target. If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} kills it and magically devours its brain.

Intelligence Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=KFKe5Uymci0DvtlZ]], each creature in a 40-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Failure: [[/damage 8d8 + 5 average type=psychic]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Stunned apply=false] condition until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn. Success: Half damage only.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectThou]{Detect Thoughts}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDisguiseSe]{Disguise Self}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageHand00]{Mage Hand} (the hand is Invisible)

1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplClairvoyan]{Clairvoyance}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDimensionD]{Dimension Door}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFireball00]{Fireball} (level 5 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLightningB]{Lightning Bolt} (level 5 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPlaneShift]{Plane Shift} (self only), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSending000]{Sending}
The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShield0000]{Shield} in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
